description: Central model configuration for Nexus agent infrastructure

marathon.description: Maximum capability - CEO-Director model with full Opus orchestration

default.description: Balanced mode - Opus for orchestration, Sonnet for implementation

sprint.description: Cost-optimized - Sonnet orchestration, Haiku for lightweight tasks

budget.description: Minimum cost - Haiku everywhere except critical orchestration

opus.notes: Opus 4.6 - Latest flagship. Superior instruction following, reliable tool use, best for orchestration and complex multi-step tasks.

sonnet.notes: Best value for implementation tasks. Strong code generation, good reasoning.

haiku.notes: Fastest and cheapest. Good for search, validation, simple edits.

opus_4_5.bestFor: Complex architectural decisions, creative feature design

improvements_over_4_5: More reliable at following complex multi-step instructions
Better at parallel tool use without errors
Improved code quality in generated output
Better at maintaining context across long sessions
opus_4_6.bestFor: Orchestration, multi-agent coordination, complex implementation, agentic workflows

agentLevelDescriptions.director: L1 Orchestrator - Routes and coordinates all agents, enforces scope, reports to CEO
agentLevelDescriptions.specialist: L2 Specialist - Domain expertise (architecture, UX, strategy, API design)
agentLevelDescriptions.worker: L3 Worker - Atomic task execution (coding, searching, validating)

adaptiveEffort.description: Per-task complexity classification. Director classifies BEFORE dispatch, overriding default agent model when appropriate.

TRIVIAL.promptPrefix: Quick task. Be direct. Complete in minimum steps.

signals: New function, component, or single bug fix

COMPLEX.promptPrefix: Complex task with cross-file dependencies. Check fix markers, dependency chains, and potential regressions before acting.
